step1_analysis.description: A folded active mixer designed to downconvert a 5 GHz RF signal to an IF frequency using a 5 GHz LO. It utilizes an NMOS differential transconductor (XM1, XM4) and a PMOS switching quad (XM5-XM8) with PMOS current sources (XM2, XM3), though the extracted netlist appears to contain topological errors (e.g., all switches routed to a single output node, and XM5's gate connected to F_PLUS instead of LO_P).

paper_reference.title: A Single-Chip Digitally Calibrated 5.15–5.825-GHz 0.18-um CMOS Transceiver for 802.11a Wireless LAN

conversion_gain.description: Ratio of the IF output voltage amplitude to the RF input voltage amplitude.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 270u * 10 * (0.6 - 0.42) = 486 uS. Gc = 2/pi * gm = 309 uS. Gain = Gc * RL = 0.309 V/V -> -10.2 dB. Due to the likely extraction error shorting all switches to a single OUT node, the differential IF currents will cancel, resulting in a very low or negative gain.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Theoretical gain is around -10 dB with a 1k load, but signal cancellation at the single output node will severely degrade this in simulation.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the mixer from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: PMOS current sources (N3=0.6V) supply approx 152 uA each. Total current = 304 uA. Power = 1.8V * 304 uA = 0.55 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the square-law model for SKY130 PMOS with Vsg=1.2V and W/L=10.

operating_frequency.description: The RF frequency range the mixer is designed to operate in.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the RF input matching and transistor fT. SKY130 fT is >40 GHz, so 5 GHz operation is well within limits.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the 802.11a WLAN band specified in the paper.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure conversion gain and power consumption by applying a 5.25 GHz RF signal and 5.24 GHz LO signal, extracting the 10 MHz IF at the output.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Folded Downconversion Mixer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 F_MINUS RFIN_N GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 F_PLUS N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 F_MINUS N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 F_PLUS RFIN_P GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUT F_PLUS F_MINUS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUT LO_P F_PLUS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 OUT LO_N F_PLUS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 OUT LO_N F_MINUS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Biasing and Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN3 N3 0 0.6
VRF_bias RF_BIAS 0 0.6
VLO_bias LO_BIAS 0 0.6

* LO signals (5.24 GHz)
VLO_P LO_P LO_BIAS dc 0 sin(0 0.5 5.24G)
VLO_N LO_N LO_BIAS dc 0 sin(0 0.5 5.24G 0 0 180)

* RF signals (5.25 GHz)
VRF_P RFIN_P RF_BIAS dc 0 sin(0 0.01 5.25G)
VRF_N RFIN_N RF_BIAS dc 0 sin(0 0.01 5.25G 0 0 180)

* IF Load (Low pass filter for 10 MHz IF)
RL OUT GND 1k
CL OUT GND 1p

.control
* Transient analysis for 5 IF cycles (10 MHz -> 100ns period)
tran 10p 500n

* Measure power consumption
meas tran I_vdd avg i(VVDD) from=200n to=500n
let power = -I_vdd * 1.8
print power

* Measure Conversion Gain
meas tran vout_max max v(out) from=200n to=500n
meas tran vout_min min v(out) from=200n to=500n
let vout_amp = (vout_max - vout_min) / 2
let cg = vout_amp / 0.01
let cg_db = 20 * log10(cg + 1e-15)
print cg_db

quit
.endc
